highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157 previews Skia m157 with fixes for rasterization, GPU text and transformed geometry.
highlights_body: The release also corrects Graphite readback and clipping, improves Vulkan error handling, and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Graphite Metal users should review the native iOS and tvOS minimum below.

breaking.title: Require iOS or tvOS 15 for Graphite Metal
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires a native runtime minimum of iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise your deployment target when using this backend. Any higher managed or framework platform minimum still applies.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157 while preserving the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

Corrects reflected square caps on zero-length hairlines, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle radii and stroke widths, and overlapping corner radii. Also fixes convex-path device-space bounds and software coverage-mask clamping.

Validates direct-mask Slug data on deserialization and drawing, handles unsupported fractional replay, and rounds text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work.

bullets.lead: Graphite clipping and GPU filter correctness
bullets.detail: Fixes Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback stride, clip-key packing and wedge inflation. Clip draws count toward pass capacity; oversized clip stacks warn and skip the draw. Displacement-filter offsets use full precision to match their computed bounds.

Corrects render-pass pointer initialization and delays device-loss cleanup by 1 ms for ARM proprietary drivers >=42 and <56. Failed fence waits now fail native synchronous submission; managed GRContext.Submit remains void and does not expose that result.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now match the cdecl convention of existing DllImport and delegate paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and companion bindings. This addresses an ABI mismatch on Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.
Fixes a native heap overflow when anti-aliased convex paths cross vertical clip gaps.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed Ganesh geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. It also aligns displacement offsets with filter bounds and propagates failed Vulkan fence waits through native synchronous submission, without adding managed failure reporting.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also delays device-loss cleanup for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to any higher framework minimum.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch without changing public APIs or native exports; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed geometry, GPU clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. Failed Vulkan fence waits now fail native synchronous submission; managed GRContext.Submit remains void and does not expose that result.
